bio_en: Gegham Ter-Karapetian, known by the pen-names Tatrak and Asoghik, was born in 1865 in Kheyrian in the Mush plain, the son of the priest Karapet. He studied at the St. Karapet monastery school until 1883 and at the Gevorgian seminary in 1885-87, and in 1888 became secretary of the Mush prelacy; after the Gyulizar affair of 1889 he married Gyulizar in 1892. Forced to leave Taron, he was prelacy secretary in Tigranakert in 1894-96, then again in Mush until the 1908 constitution, playing an important role during the Sasun fighting of 1904. He wrote many reports on the land question, and his 'Taroni Ashkharh' was published in 1931.
